title: TPotAG
description: A small mod that adds corruption. Based on TPotAG universe.
body:
_Currently, the mod serves a decorative and slightly challenging purpose. It also has some compatibility with Tetra._  
  
**It is developed mainly because of educational purposes.**  
  
A world where gods once walked the earth now lies in ruins. The Ancient Empire has fallen, leaving behind only cursed lands and secrets buried deep beneath the surface.  
  
The Path of the Ancient God is an adventure mod that places you at the heart of this dying world. Explore forgotten ruins, awaken ancient cores, fight the spawn of chaos, and resist the infection that consumes the land.  
  
Every step is a choice between order and chaos. Every decision brings you closer to the truth — or to your doom.  
  
The darkness awaits. But the light can still be found.
